datasets.name: dep1
datasets.sql:
select sp.name as musteri,
       sum(cs.FACTICALDEBT) as  dep_meblegi, 
       sum(cs.FACTICALDEBT*tmp.OSTAT) as dep_mebleginin_ekv,
       sum(cs.facticalinterestdebt) as dep_faiz_meblegi,
       sum(cs.facticalinterestdebt*tmp.OSTAT) as dep_faiz_meblegi_ekv,
      SBCM_PROLONGATION.Payment_date(SBCM_PROLONGATION.Close_date(sc.id),  SBCM_PROLONGATION.prolongation(sc.id),:v_date)as Odenish,
      SBCM_PROLONGATION.NewKod((SBCM_PROLONGATION.Payment_date(SBCM_PROLONGATION.Close_date(sc.id),  SBCM_PROLONGATION.prolongation(sc.id),:v_date)),sc.PERSONALTYPE)||'M' 
as kod
from SBCM_CONTRACTS sc,
     avalute av,
     SBCM_INTERESTS     si,
     sbcm_overdueinterests so,
     sbcm_contract_history cs,
     SBCM_PERSONS sp,
     operkurs tmp
where sc.type#=3                and
      sc.currency=av.VALUTE     and
      sc.id=si.id#              and
      sc.id=so.id#              and
      sc.id=cs.id#              and
      cs.HDATE=:v_date          and
      sc.currency=tmp.VAL_KOD   and
      sc.opendate<=:v_date    and
      sc.PERSONALTYPE=sp.id    and
      tmp.dat=(select max(dat) from operkurs where dat<=:v_date)and
      tmp.VAL_KOD=sc.currency                          

group by sp.name,SBCM_PROLONGATION.Payment_date(SBCM_PROLONGATION.Close_date(sc.id),  SBCM_PROLONGATION.prolongation(sc.id),:v_date),
 SBCM_PROLONGATION.NewKod((SBCM_PROLONGATION.Payment_date(SBCM_PROLONGATION.Close_date(sc.id),  SBCM_PROLONGATION.prolongation(sc.id),:v_date)),sc.PERSONALTYPE)

select 
 b1.id,
 b1.a,
 b1.teyinati,
 nvl(abs(round(sum(rest)/1000,2) ) ,0)  cem,
 round(sum(case when credittype=23 then rest/1000 end),2) lizing,
  min(initialamount)/1000  min_mebleg,
  max( initialamount)/1000 max_mebleg,
  min( annualyinterestrate) min_faiz,
   max( annualyinterestrate )max_faiz,
    max(periodcontracts) max_interval
 
 from bkt_5 b1,
 (select 
  nvl(( case when act.id in (60,61,62,63,65) then act.pure_id else cr.pur_id end) ,19) Teyinat,
   h.rest,
 p.credittype,
 p.periodcontracts ,
 p.annualyinterestrate,
 p.initialamount,
 cr.pur_id
       from
  cm_portfolio p,
  cm_creditcat cr,
  cm_history h,
  cm_activities act
  where 
     h.creditid=p.id 
  and cr.id=p.creditact 
  and act.id=p.activities
  and  h.hdate =:dat1
  and h.rest <>0
  and p.initialamount<>0
   ) b2 
   where b1.id=b2.Teyinat(+)
 group by
  b1.id, 
 teyinat,
 b1.a,
 b1.teyinati
 order by b1.id
